title: Run Kev: journalist-professor (4 cells, 4000 requests)
description:
**Self-contained run.** Give this issue ID to an agent on any Mac; it does the whole job by following the runbook in **BD-dd780c** (`kbs show BD-dd780c`).

**Job:** answer the registered 500-item subsample of the still-missing Kev cells for `journalist-professor`: 4 cells, exactly 6995 requests (manifest `docs/kev-runs/journalist-professor.json`, on main), roughly 11 minutes on a quiet Mac.

**Steps** (details and exact commands in the runbook)
1. Pull main. One-time setup if this Mac has not done a run.
2. Start the pinned Kev server, run `run_kev_study collect --manifest docs/kev-runs/journalist-professor.json` with the runbook's identity flags. It resumes if interrupted.
3. Commit only the finished files under `answers/kev/journalist-professor/` (never `.partial.jsonl`) to branch `runs/<this issue id>` and push that branch. Not main. No `bd replay`.
4. Comment the request count and any errors here, then close.

**Rules:** one heavy job at a time on the machine; stop the Kev server when done; never touch `project/`.
